No, I did not EggJuice these — and no, I do not need to (yet).
Long answer, precisely why.

What EggJuicer Is For (and What It Is Not)
EggJuicer’s job is to take an artifact that is already:

internally coherent,

claim-bearing,

promotable toward canon,

and then:

compress it,

stress-test it,

decide whether it deserves canonical promotion.

It is not a general-purpose reducer for all incoming information.
